summary: Issue #555 MMU-7: intent-review spec_fidelity=pass consumed as given. Injectable WorkflowOutcomeRecorder port breaks execution↔operations import cycle; worker finish path records outcomes via port; OperationsWorkflowOutcomeRecorder bound at Celery startup. 21 related unit tests pass. No reliability/security/observability/performance blockers.

criticalFindings.description: Intent-review smell (non-blocking): _collect_import_modules and _assert_no_import mirror AST import helpers in test_mmu6_celery_dispatch_ports.py.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Optional: extract shared import-graph test helpers to a conftest or test utility module.

criticalFindings.description: Intent-review smell (non-blocking): test_mmu7_bind_celery_dispatchers_wires_outcome_recorder overlaps test_mmu6_bind_celery_dispatchers_wires_domain_injectors after MMU-6 test was extended for outcome port.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Optional: consolidate bind_celery_dispatchers wiring assertions into one MMU-6/7 contract test.

criticalFindings.description: Intent-review convention note: OperationsWorkflowOutcomeRecorder follows MMU-6 Celery adapter precedent; Middle Man delegation is intentional port indirection.

criticalFindings.description: Reliability: ValueError from outcome recording is caught and logged as workflow_outcome_skipped; execution commit proceeds — intentional graceful degradation for invalid/missing workflow_id payloads.

interfaceChanges.description: Injectable Protocol port for workflow outcome recording; unbound access raises RuntimeError.
bind_celery_dispatchers now wires outcome recorder adapter delegating to operations.record_workflow_outcome public API.
execution_status parameter is str at operations boundary; removed execution.types import.

mappings.criterion: No two-way import between services.execution and services.operations.
Outcome recording remains callable from the approved execution finish path through a stable public API.
Unit tests cover outcome record via the public contract with fakes; no deep cross-imports.
Cycle check clean for this pair.
